2026-08-21.summary:
### NPC & AI
- Prevented crocodiles from dying on spawn and ensured they only spawn near rivers.

### Items & Crafting
- Adjusted bandage world model collision size and corrected its outline reference.
- Reduced fireplace deploy volume to allow placement under existing floors.
- Repaired corrupt hazmat suit prefab.
- Fixed chainsaw world model highlight and reduced highlight draw count.
- Reduced craft costs for mortar, hazmat suit, and HMLMG; made prisoner hood a default blueprint and removed it from the tech tree.

### UI & HUD
- Fixed market terminal long name rendering overflow.
- Fixed crash when switching cameras.
- Improved on-screen toast notifications.
- Fixed typo and updated text for the smart alarm device.
- Live preview of race and skin color in character customization icons; fixed preview bugs and improved tab labeling.

### World & Monuments
- Corrected collision mesh for high external wall and gate.
- Added damage-state visual effects to all blocker objects.

### Gameplay & Creatures
- Optimized train collision handling by caching HittableByTrains owner entity, reducing lookup overhead during saves.

items.text: Fixed old scientists movement and AI getting stuck, including crouch‑walk angle on stairs and slower behavior.
Improved navmesh sampling to eliminate spikes from unreachable points.
Deployables placed inside rooms now work via separate network groups.
Added a repairable helipad at the bandit camp; players must contribute resources to unlock air vehicle purchases, and it stays repaired until the next wipe.
Tuned conversation readout timings for clearer dialogue pacing.

2026-08-20.summary:

### Monuments & Structures

- Added a repairable helipad at the bandit camp; players must contribute resources to unlock air vehicle purchases, and it stays repaired until the next wipe.

### UI & Gameplay
